free_tier.stated: The selling brand publishes one price floor and no plan card: 'Uniform rental rates across all countries - from 5.77 EUR per month' on the homepage, with KVM, NVMe in RAID 10, 'ports with a speed of 1-10 Gbps', unlimited traffic and presence 'in more than 50 countries'. No page read paired that price with vCPU, RAM or disk: /en/vps renders the marketing copy but its tariff cards are client-side, and /en/vps-configurator renders no numbers. The 12 tariff names are published on the review promotion page: Aluminium, Argentum, Ruthenium, Iridium, Palladium, Osmium, Aurum, Platinum, Rhodium, Mithril, Adamantium, Obsidian. The free test is 3 days and gated on an account, a sales ticket and KYC.

egress.terms: unlimited traffic is stated: 'No Bandwidth Limits' and 'Enjoy complete freedom with unlimited traffic for your project' on the homepage, with no monthly byte figure published anywhere read

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: the order and account flow is a client area at client.the.hosting running BILLmanager, linked from the trial page as billmgr?startform=v2.vds.order.pricelist; no public API is documented on the pages read. A client would be a browser session or a wrapper around that panel. That is a tooling note, not a verdict.
chaining: nothing to chain: the operator announced permanent discontinuation of all services, disabled ordering and renewals, and said accounts and data will be deleted. A machine that will be erased is not a place to put the archive index or a crawler front end.

limits.value: The only throughput wall the pages publish is the port, quoted as 'The servers run on the ports with a speed of 1-10 Gbps', while traffic is stated as unlimited. No byte counter is published, so the port is what a daytime transfer meets first. Not probed.

identity_cost.detail: The 3-day test requires four steps, quoted: 'Authorize - Log in or sign up for THE.Hosting', 'Create a request to the sales department with the subject VPS Test', then 'KYC verification - After verification, you will receive a server to test for 3 days.' The page names KYC and does not say which document, which country, or whether a card is also required, so the rung is national-id on the page's own word and not on a document list. Payment methods are not stated on any page read.

reliability_note: 2026-05-30 first-party notice: permanent discontinuation of all services, registration, ordering and renewals disabled, accounts and data to be permanently deleted.

evidence.proved: the operator states the shutdown in its own words: 'due to unforeseen and unavoidable force majeure circumstances, The.Hosting is forced to permanently discontinue all its operational services and wind down its activities', and 'All active forms of registration, ordering, and renewals have been disabled. No new services can be purchased.', and 'Once the wind-down process is completed, all accounts and data will be permanently deleted from our systems.'
the notice is the newest item on the news index and is dated 30.05.2026 in the line above its title; the next item down is dated 23.04.2026, and no item after 30.05.2026 exists

the trial still advertises itself on a live 200 page: 'We offer you to test VPS/VDS from THE.Hosting for free for 3 days', step 4 'KYC verification' with 'After verification, you will receive a server to test for 3 days.', and the condition 'The test period can be used only once.'

the 'free VPS' promotion is not free capacity: 'get up to 30 days VPS for free just for an honest review and subscribing to our social networks', and the first condition is 'Order or extend your current VPS for at least 1 month', with 30 days for the Aluminium, Argentum and Ruthenium tariffs, 14 for Iridium to Rhodium, and 7 for Mithril, Adamantium and Obsidian

the homepage still sells, months after the notice: 'Uniform rental rates across all countries - from 5.77 EUR per month' (the page prints the euro sign; transcribed here as EUR), 'Today THE.Hosting is present in more than 50 countries', and 'No Bandwidth Limits / Enjoy complete freedom with unlimited traffic for your project'

the product page is still up and still advertises a test period in its own title, 'VPS hosting - VPS/VDS hosting rental - Buy a VPS server with a test period', and states 'The servers run on the ports with a speed of 1-10 Gbps' and 'After ordering and paying for the VPS, it will be provided to you within 15 minutes'

notes: Two pages on the same site disagree and both return 200, which is the finding. The marketing pages (homepage, /en/vps, /en/test-vps, /en/gift-vps) still advertise capacity and a 3-day trial; the news notice dated 2026-05-30 says the business is closing and ordering is disabled. The notice is newer and is the authoritative statement about availability, so the verdict is dead, but the execution was not observed: a probe of the order pricelist at client.the.hosting returned broker exit 4, which is the broker refusing and establishes nothing about the provider, and no account was created and no payment details were entered. If the wind-down is reversed, this record flips to trial-only with a 3-day test gated on KYC.
